reuse.why: Changes only the shared getScheduledAmount (which every server and client consumer already calls) and keeps using the existing getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: The rule gets simpler (Math.min and a single subtraction) and nothing is repeated.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the scheduled-amount definition lives, with the API docs updated alongside.

scope.why: One helper, its tests and the matching API doc text; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: A two-line rule change in the single definition, covered by tests for outgoing, incoming and zero-spanning ranges.
